question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The concert was _______ due to the bad weather.
solution:
The correct answer is '**cancelled**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**cancelled**" means to decide that an event will not take place. (रद्द किया गया)
 
• The concert was called off due to the bad weather, which is appropriately expressed by the word "**cancelled**".
 
• The other options: "**celebrated**," "**continued**," and "**commenced**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The concert was cancelled__ due to the bad weather.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Celebrated (मनाया गया)**: means to honor or mark an occasion.
 
• **Continued (जारी रखा)**: means to carry on or persist.
 
• **Commenced (शुरू किया गया)**: means to begin or start.
